responseText:
I haven't seen them do that, yet, no, but the way they treat those Ramkins, It's almost as if, and I know this sounds crazy, but these Minotaur are worse than even the monsters in grandfather's stories.

Have you seen their horns? It's as if they're on fire. Spooky, right? But then, the Ramkin they push around? Those things are dumb as a fist - they'll wade right through danger like it's not even there, just to pick up a rock that their masters fancy.

I think they're all cursed. I've been paying close attention to these things, and I think they're under some kinda spell. 

Wish I had some idea what to do about it.
